sloka: तस्मै दृढधनुः क्रुद्धो हताश्वाय विभीषणः।वज्रस्पर्शसमान् पञ्च ससर्जोरसि मार्गणान् ।। ६.९१.४४ ।।
transliteration: tasmai dṛḍhadhanuḥ kruddho hatāśvāya vibhīṣaṇaḥ।vajrasparśasamān pañca sasarjorasi mārgaṇān ।। 6.91.44 ।।

translations.english: Observing the javelin coming towards him, Lakshmana, the delight of Raghus and enhancer of Sumithra's joy, split it into ten pieces, which had fallen on the ground.
